C0264.title: Netizen Stitches Video to Fabricate “Guangzhou Train Station Flooded” Rumor for Traffic and Follower Growth, Penalized
C0264.summary: Guangzhou police reported that a netizen around 30 years old stitched past disaster footage together with typhoon footage during a June 2025 storm and published rumors claiming that a high-speed rail station had been flooded and 800,000 people were desperately seeking help. The content spread online, and public security authorities penalized the netizen for fabricating rumors to attract traffic.
